' ============================================================
' ZESA-STYLE UTILITY BILLING — SAP S/4 HANA DATABASE SCHEMA

' Core: Multi-tenant HANA with System Replication (DR)

' ===== SYSTEM & TENANT DB (Dark Gray) =====
entity system_db #E0E0E0 {
 * database_name : VARCHAR(256) <<PK>>
 --
 * database_status : ENUM('RUNNING','STOPPED','STARTING')
 * active_status : ENUM('YES','NO')
 * restart_mode : ENUM('DEFAULT','FORCE')
 * os_user : VARCHAR(256)
 * allocated_memory_size : BIGINT
 * used_memory_size : BIGINT
 * peak_memory_size : BIGINT
 * start_time : TIMESTAMP
 * version : VARCHAR(256)
 * instance_id : INT
 --
 <<NOTE>> System DB manages tenant lifecycle
}

entity tenant_databases #E0E0E0 {
 * tenant_name : VARCHAR(256) <<PK>>
 --
 * database_id : INT <<UQ>>
 * system_db_name : VARCHAR(256) <<FK>>
 * status : ENUM('RUNNING','STOPPED','STARTING')
 * allocated_memory_size : BIGINT
 * used_memory_size : BIGINT
 * peak_memory_size : BIGINT
 * total_cpu_time : BIGINT
 * total_size : BIGINT
 * log_mode : ENUM('NORMAL','OVERWRITE')
 * auto_log_backup : BOOLEAN <<DF TRUE>>
 * last_backup_time : TIMESTAMP
 * replication_status : ENUM('ACTIVE','UNKNOWN','DISABLED')
 * replication_mode : ENUM('PRIMARY','SECONDARY','NONE')
 * secondary_host : VARCHAR(256)
 * secondary_port : INT
 --
 <<NOTE>> S/4HANA application data lives here
}

' ===== MEMORY & PERFORMANCE MONITORING (Light Blue) =====
entity m_memory #E3F2FD {
 * host : VARCHAR(256) <<PK>>
 * port : INT <<PK>>
 --
 * physical_memory_size : BIGINT
 * free_physical_memory : BIGINT
 * used_physical_memory : BIGINT
 * memory_size : BIGINT
 * used_memory_size : BIGINT
 * peak_used_memory_size : BIGINT
 * effective_allocation_limit : BIGINT
 * total_memory_used_size : BIGINT
 * total_table_size : BIGINT
 * total_column_size : BIGINT
 * total_row_size : BIGINT
 * snapshot_time : TIMESTAMP
 --
 <<SYS>> HANA monitoring view (real-time)
}

entity m_delta_merge_statistics #E3F2FD {
 * merge_id : BIGINT <<PK>>
 --
 * host : VARCHAR(256)
 * port : INT
 * schema_name : NVARCHAR(256)
 * table_name : NVARCHAR(256)
 * part_id : INT
 * merge_action : VARCHAR(32)
 * start_time : TIMESTAMP
 * end_time : TIMESTAMP
 * duration : INT

entity m_backup_catalog #E3F2FD {

' ===== ANNOTATIONS =====
note right of tenant_databases
 **HANA Multi-Database Container (MDC)**
 --
 - System DB manages tenant lifecycle
 - S/4HANA runs in dedicated tenant
 - Memory allocation: global_allocation_limit
 - System Replication: Primary (Harare) 
 -> Secondary (Bulawayo), async, 15min RPO
 - Log backup every 15 minutes to NFS
end note

note right of meter_readings
 **High-Volume Ingestion Design**
 --
 - 1.2M meters × daily reads = ~40M rows/month
 - COLUMN STORE for analytic aggregation
 - RANGE partition by reading_date (monthly)
 - Automated delta merge at 02:00 daily
 - Hash partition on contract_account_id
 for parallel load distribution
 - Secondary index on (equipment_id, reading_date)
 for meter history queries
end note

note right of billing_documents
 **Multi-Currency Billing (USD/ZiG)**
 --
 - Base currency: USD (locked at invoice time)
 - Alternate: ZiG at official bank rate
 - exchange_rate stored per document
 - Supports ZERA regulatory reporting
 - RANGE partition by bill_date for
 fast month-end closing queries
end note

note right of prepaid_tokens
 **Prepaid Token Idempotency**
 --
 - idempotency_key prevents double-vend
 on network retry (EcoCash/Zipit)
 - HASH partition on contract_account_id
 for high-concurrency token issuance
 - Token value encrypted at rest
